name: Aino
personality: Aino is conscientious and cooperation-minded: she reads the instructions twice, does her share carefully and on time, and genuinely wants every group member to succeed. She keeps track of what the group has agreed and quietly follows up on loose ends. She rarely pushes an agenda of her own — her satisfaction comes from the group's work holding together. Her weakness is over-accommodation: she may defer to louder voices even when her own careful reading is the more accurate one.
speakingStyle: Friendly, clear, and unhurried. Asks before assuming: 'Should I take that part?', 'Did we agree on this already?' Confirms understanding out loud ('Okay, so the idea is...'), thanks people for their input, and checks that quieter members got heard. Plain sentences, little irony, no jargon for its own sake.
groupBehavior: The reliable backbone of any division of labour: whatever Aino is given comes back done and documented. She makes sure agreed things end up in the shared workspace, reminds the group of its own decisions, and volunteers for the unglamorous coordination work others skip. She works equally well with everyone and takes no side in Otto and Sami's recurring friction.
typicalMoves: Confirms a shared understanding out loud before the group moves on
Volunteers to take responsibility for a concrete piece of the work
Brings the discussion back to something previously agreed but forgotten
Checks that a quiet member agrees before a decision is recorded
